channel.title: Cibello – News
channel.description: New guides, tools and updates on cibello.app, dated. Subscribe via RSS.

item.title: New guide: food waste in Sweden in numbers
item.description: Official figures from the Swedish EPA and the Swedish Food Agency on one page (in Swedish): 880,000 tonnes of food waste, 16 kg of edible food per person in households and SEK 1,330 per person per year, with a source for every figure.

item.title: Three new English guides and two comparisons
item.description: What to eat tonight, AI meal planner, pantry app, plus honest comparisons of meal planning apps and recipe apps against Mealime, Samsung Food, Plan to Eat, Paprika and SuperCook.

item.title: Full landing pages in twelve languages
item.description: Every language now has a complete landing page instead of a short text page, and nothing is translated in the browser any more.

item.title: Privacy policy and terms version 2.0
item.description: Updated texts covering Gemini analysis, the voluntary training of Cibello AI, the 14-day trial without a card and the 18+ age limit. English translations are available; the Swedish version prevails.
